name: Call of the Grave makes Animate: Bone Construct instant and free (#7311)
contract: Call of the Grave 707738 (trainer spell, SkillLineAbility 24746) reads "Beckon the dead, removing the cost and cast time of all Raise spells and Animates for $d." Effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER MiscValue 14 (SPELLMOD_COST) with EffectSpellClassMask (0x8, 0x10000, 0x20000000) and effect 1 MiscValue 10 (SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME) with (0x8, 0x10000, 0), both BasePoints -101 + 1 = -100, in SpellFamilyName 29. Raise and Animate summons carry family flag word 0 0x8, but Animate: Bone Construct 531130 (CharacterAdvancement 11619, Animation tab; CastingTimeIndex 14 = 3000 ms, 300 Runic Power) has family flags (0, 0, 0) in the client Spell.dbc, so no modifier matched it. The load contract gives it the Animate flag word 0 0x8, which the other matching modifiers also intend for it: Graverobber 503757 ('Raise and Animate spells') and Grave Mastery 504439 ('all Animates, Raises, and Command spells'). Expected: without the buff Animate: Bone Construct takes 3 sec and costs Runic Power; with Call of the Grave active it is instant and free, and a real cast raises the Bone Construct 503200 without spending Runic Power.
